description: Send a booking request to the property (hotel, B&B, guesthouse or vacation rental) for a room or unit and dates. The resulting stay contract is directly between the guest and the property; Bookd is only the booking platform. Only call after the guest has confirmed the room, dates, guests, and given their name and email. Returns a booking_id and, when online payments are on, a payment_url for the deposit (card held, charged only if the owner accepts). Usually status is "requested": the request is emailed to the property (the guest is emailed when it answers) and the room is held until the owner answers or the request expires. Instant booking: for properties with instant_booking=true, Bookd checks the room live in the property's own booking system; if it is available, the booking is made there at once and status is "confirmed" (with the booking_id; the guest and property are emailed). With a deposit, the reply has instant_booking=true and a payment_url, and the booking is confirmed as soon as the deposit is paid (check booking_status). If the live check or write fails it stays a normal request; if the room was just taken, an error says nothing was booked. Only tell the guest it is confirmed when status is "confirmed". Not idempotent: each call creates a new request, so do not retry after a booking_id is returned (use booking_status). The guest pays the property directly; Bookd never handles guest money.

creator_code.description: Optional: a creator or promo code the guest mentions (e.g. from a video). Only pass one the guest gave you; never invent or suggest one.

message.description: Note for the owner, e.g. arrival time

room.description: Room name from check_availability; omit for the cheapest free room

name: request_booking
title: Request a booking
